policy: Shared filled MPlantin type typography in original and Oracle modes, with absolute set origins and unchanged symbol clearance. No per-card render offsets or new scan poses. Fourth Edition land and nonland type origins are consistent. Regional indexes are not whole-card correctness percentages. Font-family replacement, rules text, footers and final release gates remain separate.

metrics.method: 0.30 dual-polarity edge index + 0.40 signed local contrast + 0.30 filled-area agreement; balanced by material, distinct name, then printing. Fixed type crop and two-pixel inset sensitivity crop. Similarity indexes, not correctness percentages.

fem.policy: Geometry frozen. Solid MPlantin strokes only; seven perimeter trims. Gray is estimated from the 85th percentile of >=90% coverage glyph cores, with >=16 pixels per card, >=70% of calibration printings and >=2 distinct names in every material. Balanced by material/name. Gray is never selected by edge maximization. Signed contrast/filled area remain 70% of the trim-selection objective. Sparse/ambiguous cores and rejected trials stay visible; native/visual review is required.

outliers.review: Visually inspected all eleven scan/current/candidate sheets covering both cohorts, every material and selected low/regressing examples. Solid filled MPlantin type improves placement and stroke weight. Fourth Edition land type now uses the same absolute left origin as other materials. No hollow lettering candidates were used. Fixed crops show no overflow or width clipping. Retain all seven printing-level regressions; do not add card-specific render offsets. Scan/plate/letterform variation remains unresolved, especially Chronicles gold.

goldFollowup.review: Inspected all eighteen gold-card candidates. A material-only hypothesis gives only a small mean gain (training .68495 to .69412; reused validation .47975 to .49134) and retains the same low-scoring cluster. Keep the simpler shared set profile and retain this diagnostic; no extra material override adopted. This was a post-validation hypothesis, not independent validation.
